title: AI Voices 每日精选
subtitle: 研究者公开观点、研究发布与重要讨论。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: @arcprize：ARC-AGI-4 will be a benchmark for autonomous open-ended innovation. It will continue our commitment to open-source, givi
items.abstract_or_text: ARC-AGI-4 will be a benchmark for autonomous open-ended innovation. It will continue our commitment to open-source, giving the research community a shared target for progress that benefits all of humanity. Despite rapid model progress, humans still significantly outperform AI at open-ended invention. Open source is the foundation for that progress. Any coordinated effort by the AI industry to reduce openness or concentrate access to frontier AI would undermine that positive-sum future.
items.summary_zh: ARC Prize 官方账号宣布，ARC-AGI-4 将定位为“自主开放式创新”的基准，并强调开源与共享评测目标。人类仍明显强于 AI 的表述是该机构在帖文中的判断。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该帖提供了下一代 ARC 基准的明确定位，并把开放性与评测基础设施联系起来；其对能力差距和产业开放性的结论仍应视为发布方立场。
items.abstract_zh: ARC-AGI-4 将成为衡量自主开放式创新的基准。它将延续我们对开源的承诺，为研究社区提供一个共同的进步目标，惠及全人类。尽管模型进展迅速，人类在开放式发明上的表现仍明显优于 AI。开源是这一进步的基础。AI 行业任何削弱开放性或集中前沿 AI 获取权的协同行动，都将损害这种正和的未来。

items.title: @Zyvex_0x：Someone open sourced an entire animal. Not a model of an animal. The animal. A fruit fly, rebuilt joint by joint from mi
items.abstract_or_text: Someone open sourced an entire animal. Not a model of an animal. The animal. A fruit fly, rebuilt joint by joint from microscopy, that walks, grips, flies and lands inside a physics engine running on your laptop. It's called flybody. Built by Google DeepMind and HHMI Janelia, published in Nature, and sitting on GitHub under Apache 2.0 right now.
items.summary_zh: 帖文称 Google DeepMind 与 HHMI Janelia 制作了名为 flybody 的数字果蝇：它由显微数据逐关节重建，可在本地物理引擎中完成多种动作，并已发表于 Nature、以 Apache 2.0 许可证置于 GitHub。候选文本未附论文或代码链接。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若原帖所述来源与开放状态可由论文和代码库复核，这会是连接连接组、具身模拟与可复用研究资产的重要案例；动作能力与实现细节不应仅据这条二手帖文外推。
items.abstract_zh: 有人把一整只动物开源了。不是一个动物模型，而是这只动物本身。一只果蝇从显微图像出发被逐关节重建，在你笔记本电脑上运行的物理引擎中行走、抓握、飞行和着陆。它叫 flybody，由 Google DeepMind 和 HHMI Janelia 构建，发表于 Nature，现在以 Apache 2.0 许可证放在 GitHub 上。

items.title: @cohere：On the WMT benchmark (averaged across all languages), North Small Translate achieves an 83.6 score, outperforming models
items.abstract_or_text: On the WMT benchmark (averaged across all languages), North Small Translate achieves an 83.6 score, outperforming models such as DeepL and Google Translate as well as open options, including GLM 5.2 and Mistral Large 3.
items.summary_zh: Cohere 官方账号称，其 North Small Translate 在跨语言平均的 WMT 基准上得分 83.6，高于 DeepL、Google Translate、GLM 5.2 和 Mistral Large 3 等模型。该比较是发布方在未于候选文本说明的评测设置下作出的陈述。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 机器翻译模型同时与闭源和开放模型比较，具有工程选型参考价值；但单一平均分不足以判断特定语言、领域或延迟成本下的实际表现。
items.abstract_zh: 在 WMT 基准上（对所有语言取平均），North Small Translate 获得 83.6 分，优于 DeepL 和 Google Translate 等模型，也优于包括 GLM 5.2 和 Mistral Large 3 在内的开放选项。

items.title: @fchollet：I hope the proposals by frontier labs to pace AI research stem from a genuine concern for safety and a recognition of th
items.abstract_or_text: I hope the proposals by frontier labs to pace AI research stem from a genuine concern for safety and a recognition of the potential risks posed by future models, rather than a strategic effort to consolidate power and permanently solidify the market dominance of a few top players. If these efforts are genuine, then oversight must take a more democratic and accountable form, with both national and international components, similar to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission in the US and the International Atomic Energy Agency internationally. Two potential warning signs of regulatory capture: 1. Calls to ban open-source AI. 2. Attempts to hinder non-frontier research.
items.summary_zh: François Chollet 表示，他希望前沿实验室放缓 AI 研究的提议源于安全关切而非巩固市场力量；他主张监督应更民主、可问责，并列出限制开源和阻碍非前沿研究两项可能的监管俘获信号。这是作者的政策观点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该观点把风险治理、竞争结构和研究开放性置于同一讨论框架，提出了可供专业社群检验与反驳的具体制度判断，而非能力事实声明。
items.abstract_zh: 我希望前沿实验室提出放缓 AI 研究的建议，源于对安全的真切关心和对未来模型潜在风险的认识，而不是为了集中权力、永久巩固少数顶尖公司的市场主导地位而作出的战略努力。如果这些努力是真诚的，那么监督必须采取更民主、更可问责的形式，并同时具有国家和国际层面，类似美国核管理委员会和国际原子能机构。有两种监管俘获的潜在警告信号：1. 呼吁禁止开源 AI。2. 试图阻碍非前沿研究。

items.title: @jackclarkSF：Proud of this statement from Dario on pacing - as anyone close to the technology knows, AI seems to be on a trajectory t
items.abstract_or_text: Proud of this statement from Dario on pacing - as anyone close to the technology knows, AI seems to be on a trajectory to progress far faster than the rate at which society can adapt to its capabilities and risks. AI is an amazingly positive technology - and an incredibly powerful one. For us to truly benefit from it we need to treat it seriously. We need to find ways to slow the frontier of development, such that we can better deal with collective action problems and buy ourselves more time for understanding the properties of these systems and how they need to be handled. On a personal note, as a parent of young children, it is an everyday crazymaking occurrence to reflect on how little the development of literal superintelligence is regulated relative to the food and toys I buy for my children.
items.summary_zh: Jack Clark 支持 Dario 关于“减速”的声明，认为 AI 能力进展可能快于社会适应风险和能力的速度；他据此主张放慢前沿开发，以处理集体行动问题并争取理解系统性质的时间。这是作者的规范性判断。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 帖文具体说明了“减速”主张所针对的社会适应与集体行动机制，为能力发展速度和治理节奏之间的关系提供了一种可讨论的论证。
items.abstract_zh: 我为 Dario 关于减速的这份声明感到自豪——任何接近这一技术的人都知道，AI 似乎正沿着一条进步速度远快于社会适应其能力和风险速度的轨道前行。AI 是一种极为积极的技术，也是一种极其强大的技术。要真正从中获益，我们需要认真对待它。我们需要找到放慢前沿开发的方法，以便更好地处理集体行动问题，并为理解这些系统的性质及其应如何被处置争取更多时间。就个人而言，作为年幼孩子的父亲，每天想到字面意义上的超级智能开发所受监管比我给孩子买的食品和玩具还少得多，都会让我近乎抓狂。

items.title: @Thom_Wolf：Some notes from the Fields Medal letter today (https://mathandai.org/). Generally saying that AI models riffling through
items.abstract_or_text: Some notes from the Fields Medal letter today (https://mathandai.org/). Generally saying that AI models riffling through solving these problems gives 1 bit of signal while killing the 99 other bits of conceptual understanding that mathematicians would have extracted from fighting with these problems
items.summary_zh: Thom Wolf 就一封与 AI 和数学有关的公开信写下读后注：他概括其主张为，模型快速求解问题只带来“1 比特”信号，却会损失数学家通过与问题搏斗获得的大量概念理解。这是作者对所链接公开信的转述。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该观点将讨论从答案是否正确推进到研究训练中概念形成的价值；“1 比特/99 比特”是修辞性概括而非候选文本中的实证度量。
items.abstract_zh: 关于今天那封菲尔兹奖得主公开信的一些笔记（https://mathandai.org/）。总体意思是，AI 模型快速翻找并求解这些问题，只获得 1 比特信号，却扼杀数学家通过同这些问题搏斗本可提取出的另外 99 比特概念理解。

review.note: 完整候选集共 60 项；31 项初评分达到 65。入选 6 项，已排除同一发布的重复帖文、无上下文情绪表达、活动宣传、未经充分支撑的传闻及营销式主张。X 内容来自 Grok 检索缓存，仅代表候选中收录的公开帖文，并非官方 X API 全量。
